deliberation: Revision 1 supplies a usable definition of semantic equivalence and an explicit E2 conformance procedure. The architecture recommendation is falsifiable.
discharged_obligations: Checked that the claimed boundary can be tested, compared, and disproved.
findings: Semantic equivalence covers cuts, resolved facts, derived tuples, policy visibility, provenance, proof traces, and admission outcomes.
The proposed hostile cases can expose hidden semantic dependence on FABRIC.
conditions: E2 must compare canonical semantic outputs while operational metadata exclusions are schema-defined.
Hostile duplication, reordering, loss, replay, restart, invalid-envelope, and forged-advertisement cases must be fail-capable.
E3 and E4 advancement must bind exact evidence revisions.
residual_uncertainty: Performance acceptability and interface survival under real distributed load remain empirical questions.
